name: Sling Firepots
description: Fragile sling-fired incendiary capsules intended to shatter and ignite on impact.
narrative_effects: Supports small-scale ignition, distraction, or fire-setting through sling delivery.

mechanical_effect.trigger: launched from a compatible sling at a target or area where a fragile incendiary capsule can shatter and ignite
mechanical_effect.applies_to: checks to set small fires, create fiery distraction, or deliver small-scale ignition through sling firepot impact
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: nonflammable or soaked targets; precision attacks where shattering ignition is irrelevant; situations where fire would not help
